user.title: Connect to Pantry
user.description: On the PC that runs Pantry, double-click ha-integration-token.bat in the Pantry folder. It shows the address and token to enter here.

data_description.url: Pantry on your network, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8765 (ha-integration-token.bat shows it)

reauth_confirm.title: New Pantry token
reauth_confirm.description: Pantry didn't accept the saved token. Run ha-integration-token.bat on the PC and paste the token it shows.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Pantry at that address. Check that the PC is on and Pantry is running, and that the address matches what ha-integration-token.bat shows.
error.invalid_auth: Pantry didn't accept that token. Run ha-integration-token.bat again and copy the token it shows.
error.pantry_outdated: Pantry on the PC is version {pantry_version}; this integration needs {needed} or later. Update Pantry on the PC, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This Pantry is already set up. Its address and token were updated.
abort.wrong_pantry: That's a different Pantry from the one set up here. To switch, delete this one and add the new one.

pantry_outdated.title: Update Pantry on your PC
pantry_outdated.description: Pantry on your PC is version {pantry_version}, but this Pantry integration needs {needed} or later. Some sensors may be missing or wrong until you update Pantry on the PC. This notice goes away within 5 minutes of the update.

integration_outdated.title: Update the Pantry integration
integration_outdated.description: Pantry on your PC (version {pantry_version}) needs version {needed} or later of the Pantry integration; this one is {version}. Update it in HACS and restart Home Assistant. This notice goes away after that.
